raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Count by fragments. First count the benzene ring as 6 ring bonds. Add the upper acyl/alkyl side chain: aryl–carbonyl C, C=O, carbonyl C–alkyl C, and alkyl C–R1 = 4 bonds. Add the aryl–N bond = 1, excluding the N–H bond. Add the lower-right fragment: N–C, C–O, C=C, and C–R2 = 4 bonds. Sum 6 + 4 + 1 + 4 to obtain 15.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一个苯环，苯环上方连接一个羰基侧链，侧链中有 C=O，并继续连接到带 R1 的碳。苯环下方连接一个 N，N 上画有 H，但题目要求排除涉及氢的键。N 还连接到右下方的片段，该片段包含 N-C、C-O、C=C 以及连接到 R2 的 C-R2 键。图中还有若干弯箭头，但题目说明要忽略箭头。
推理：按指定片段计数。苯环作为 6 个环键。上方酰基/烷基侧链包括 aryl-C(=O) 的连接、C=O、羰基 C-烷基 C、烷基 C-R1，共 4 个键。苯环与 N 的 aryl-N 键为 1 个，N-H 键排除。右下方片段包括 N-C、C-O、C=C、C-R2，共 4 个键。因此总数为 6 + 4 + 1 + 4 = 15。
